verdict.rationale: Cake documents a separate My Cake Portal where investors and employees view their own holdings. Admins control what investors see, linked share certificates are available in the portal, and stakeholder portals are included even on the free plan. The 'structured updates' half rests only on a single vague marketing line about communicating with investors during a capital raise. Missing for 10: documented structured investor-update or reporting features (scheduled updates, notifications to investors), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the investor portal experience.
